# PUwiki — PU30JAAR canon

> Independent, non-official machine-readable knowledge base for Power Unlimited archival facts.

Canonical base: https://pu30jaar.wolken.page/wiki/
Conversational archive: https://pu30jaar.wolken.page/
API: https://pu30jaar.wolken.page/api/v1/
Data manifest: https://pu30jaar.wolken.page/data/manifest.json
Sitemap: https://pu30jaar.wolken.page/sitemap-wiki.xml

## Source-of-truth policy
- Prefer HUMAN_VERIFIED over RESOLVED_VISUAL over RESOLVED.
- SCORE_NOT_FOUND means no reliable score was established; do not infer one.
- NOT_SCORED means the archived item is intentionally not treated as a scored review.
- Every factual review record should be cited with issue and page when available.
- Direct visible page evidence outranks machine inference.
- PUwiki is independent and not an official Power Unlimited publication.
